import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP']

# daily totals to see the anomaly
daily = acct.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_index()
print(daily.tail(10))

# For the anomaly date, compare each resource's cost to its recent baseline
target = '2025-09-22'
d = acct[acct.date==target]
base = acct[(acct.date>= '2025-09-01') & (acct.date < target)]

def key(r): return (r.csp, r.cloud_service, r.application, r.instance_family)

res = d.copy()
res['k'] = res.apply(key, axis=1)
b = base.groupby(list(res.columns[:-2]) + ['k'])['unblended_cost'].mean()
res = res.set_index('k').join(b.rename('base_mean'), on='k')
res['delta'] = res['unblended_cost'] - res['base_mean'].fillna(0)
print(res.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(15))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()

daily = acct.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_index()
print(daily.loc['2025-09-18':'2025-09-26'])

target = pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22')
cols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
d = acct[acct.date==target].copy()
base = acct[(acct.date>='2025-09-01') & (acct.date<target)]
bm = base.groupby(cols)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','sum'])
d = d.merge(bm, on=cols, how='left')
d['delta'] = d['unblended_cost'] - d['mean'].fillna(0)
top = d.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(12)
print(top[cols+['unblended_cost','mean','delta']].to_string())
# also check num_instances changes
bi = base.groupby(cols)['num_instances'].mean()
d2 = d.merge(bi.rename('base_inst'), on=cols)
print(d2.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(12)[cols+['num_instances','base_inst']].to_string())
